description: WP3 (thesis_v2): does metal chemistry drive cross-metal transfer? Descriptor-distance matrix, distance-vs-measured-transfer correlation, and a CATE model that adds metal descriptors to ligand ECFP4.
unit: ROC-AUC (0-1); distances are z-normalised Euclidean; rho is Spearman
data_source: MetalCytoToxDB (Krasnov et al., J. Med. Chem. 2026, 69(8), 8838)

metal_distance_matrix.normalisation: per-column z-score across the 5 metals, then Euclidean

distance_vs_transfer.caveat: n=3 metal pairs share matched ligands -- this correlation is data-limited and reported as an observation, not a finding.

cate_with_metal.verdict_note: delta=0.0031 < 0.02 -> metal descriptors add no meaningful signal; relabelled under the corrected rule (numbers unchanged)

acceptance.distance_vs_transfer_note: n=3 metal pairs -- below the n>=5 bar, so the correlation is reported but not accepted as evidence.

honest_framing.caveat: The distance-vs-transfer correlation is n=3 (only 3 metal pairs share matched ligands); the CATE-with-metal model is the load-bearing result.
